'''Plum Tantrellius''' was an [[Actor/Legends|actress]], daughter of Master Thespian, [[Damien Tantrellius]], who starred as [[Leia (character)|Leia]] in ''[[Two Jedi Men From Baronis]]'', the followup [[Jediboh Opera]] play to ''[[Jedi Men From Baronis]]''.<ref name="pob">{{SpaceFantasyGamerCite|88|Peekoine Opera Blues}}</ref>
